findings.text: the pairs section and the bold headline (fragment.py:166) assert that every one of the 38 pairs above 1e9 is a moment-1 psi_RR entry within 5.5e-13 m of a vertex; attribute.json holds 37 such pairs and one, node 637 cell 221, whose largest entry is moment-2 psi_RR at 3.7044e9 with a vertex distance of 5.7334e-13 m

the jump section hardcodes about 3e5 as the row-value change a genuine 3.77e15 second derivative would require across a 2e-9 m stencil; no record carries either figure and 3.77e15 x 2e-9 is 7.5e6, so the claim is unsourced and off by roughly a factor of 25

the inverse-second-moment singular values (4.63e7 and 5.14e6 m^-2 against 320 and 201 for cell 38) are typed into the renderer rather than read from any of the four records, so the module docstring's claim that every number is read from the records does not hold and these cannot be re-derived from the cited artifacts

the page concludes the booked psi_RR is a property of the derivative rule and not of the value graph, yet its stable-pole arm reads the primal row through _packed_analytic_moments_primal(stable_poles=True) (kernel.py:76-82) and the page's own jump table records that arm's row value stepping from -1.0386e-6 at +1e-9 m to -1.4716e-7 at +1e-12 m, a discontinuity in that formulation's value path rather than a tangent-only effect

point_segment_distance re-implements the point-to-segment distance the repository already owns at nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py:81, and attribute.py:55 duplicates it again, so one geometry measure now has three implementations instead of one

jets reproduces nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:323 _source_jets line for line with only the row function swapped and jump.py repeats the same arm plumbing again, while the brief named derive_rows.py's subprocess-plus-PYTHONPATH pattern as the reuse route for this row-program swap

the evidence record carries four tables and no figure, where nova/AGENTS.md's plotting rules require a GS forward-solve evidence record of a bank row to show its poloidal flux contour panels with both null sets and the wall, and the subject here is geometry a reader can only see as a panel of the offending nodes against their source cells

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a fragment naming the node-cell pairs that carry the ITER bank's second-derivative blowup, comparing the certified bank with the rerun rebuilds and attributing the construction; docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-hessian-blowup.html answers all four brief questions with tables rendered from measured records
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, five commits, the four measurement jobs with their logs, and a checkpoint naming the no-nova-path check, and its artifacts block quotes census.log's maxima
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are the fragment and scripts/prototypes/bank_hessian_blowup; all six changed paths lie inside them

justifications.durability: the diff adds no test and no assertion, and fragment.py:4 claims every number is read from the records while fragment.py:430 hardcodes one, so nothing reddens if the rendered prose drifts
